answer: Every applicant faces the same trial, Dam gate keeper corn bran milled at the millrace, and every verdict reads the same way: each corn is a year of millhouse logs in the granary ledger. Read the marble first: if it holds, read the prism; if that holds, read the pearl; a farm fails at the second step and never reaches the third. Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm. An honest proof costs 177 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 135 of them, which totals 23895 POA. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath.
